page.overview:
What is Iron Leaves?

Iron Leaves has black colored sclera and a green, metallic skin. The glowing parts on its forehead and neck can transform to look like longswords that work like weapons. It resembles Virizion but mechanical and more robot like.

Iron Leaves is the only Pokémon that can learn Psyblade.

The only currently known way to find Iron Leaves is via Tera Raid events.{{Game Locations

Iron Leaves is a futuristic counterpart to Virizion. The glowing parts on it's forehead and neck could likely be based on the crossguard lightsaber from Star Wars. Meaning these plasma blades can extend out into sharp swords similar to a rapier sword capable of cutting down large trees and boulders explained in the Violet Pokedex entry.
